sanskrit_verse: कारणादनिमित्तं वा यदा क्रोधवशं गतः। प्रजा दहति भूपालस्तदाग्निरभिधीयते॥
transliteration: kāraṇād animittaṃ vā yadā krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ | prajā dahati bhūpālas tadāgnir abhidhīyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a ruler, driven by anger and devoid of cause or justification, burns his subjects, he becomes Fire itself — not as punishment, but as the inevitable consequence of misaligned consciousness manifesting destruction.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from conscious alignment with Dharma; deviation results in ontological inversion.
Causation arises from consciousness disorder, not external provocation.
Capacity-based responsibility is absolute for rulers due to their structural dominance over collective welfare.
Restoration logic demands re-alignment of sovereign consciousness before societal harmony can be restored.
Consciousness alignment determines the efficacy and legitimacy of governance.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler_action = krodhavaśa AND consequence = prajā_dahati THEN ruler_status = agni_upāsaka
IF ruler_consciousness ≠ dharmic_center THEN governance_legitimacy = null UNTIL realignment_occurs
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a sovereign acts under uncontrolled emotional impulse causing widespread harm, that individual ceases to function as ruler and enters the state of Agni — indicating irreversible loss of constitutional capacity. The court must then invoke immediate transfer protocols to a Dharmically aligned interim council without punitive hearing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unchecked krodha disrupts causal coherence between leadership and protection. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how internal disorder manifests externally as societal combustion. Responsibility is proportional to structural power; thus, no corrective suffering is required—only removal from seat of authority until restoration occurs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sovereign Consciousness Audit via Samadhi-based Inquiry
Enact Temporary Governance Transfer to Dharmic Oversight Council
Assign Completion Process for Emotional-Causal Discharge Under Spiritual Supervision
Reintegrate Ruler Only Upon Verified Re-establishment of Inner Alignment With Prajna-Sakti
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: where consciousness fails, form follows fire. Thus, Dharma is restored through withdrawal of false authority, not infliction of pain. Consciousness alone remains the ultimate judge, jury, and executioner of truth.
